sections.text_helper: Section 27.8.9 "AES initialization vector register 0 (AES_IVR0)" in chapter 27 (AES hardware accelerator (AES)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 831.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x020
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 IVI[31:0]: Initialization vector input, bits [31:0]
AES_IVRx registers store the 128-bit initialization vector or the nonce, depending on the chaining
mode selected. This value is updated by hardware after each computation round (when applicable).
Write to this register is ignored when EN bit is set in AES_CR register
